mapper.insert: insert into attendance (att_qty, att_datetime, att_status, party_no, user_no, user_name) values (#{attQty}, now(), '대기', #{partyNo}, #{userNo}, #{userName})
mapper.select: select a.att_no, a.att_qty, a.att_datetime, a.att_status, a.party_no, p.party_title as partyTitle from attendance a join party p on a.party_no = p.party_no where a.user_no = #{userNo}

select a.att_no, a.att_qty, a.att_datetime, a.att_status, a.party_no, a.user_no, p.party_title, a.user_name from attendance a join party p on a.party_no = p.party_no where p.user_no = #{userNo} order by a.att_datetime desc
select att_no, att_qty, att_datetime, att_status, party_no, user_no from attendance where party_no = #{partyNo}
select att_no, att_qty, att_datetime, att_status, party_no, user_no from attendance where att_no = #{attNo}
